entries.what: Brenda's Monday check-in email lands at 8:15 while Judith, back from her weekend in Tamsen city, rearranges the pantry. Elliot skims it during Theo's 9 a.m. crib nap and logs the morning in the app.
entries.outcome: Reads the email, postpones replying until evening.

entries.what: Stroller walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk with Theo in the late morning, squeaky front wheel and all.
entries.outcome: Theo naps in the stroller; Elliot gets 40 minutes of quiet.

entries.what: Witching hour from 5 to 8 p.m.; Elliot hums the slowed-down ballpark organ tune while Hana eats dinner standing up.
entries.outcome: Theo finally settles at 7:50.

entries.what: Elliot opens the fridge and finds Judith has relabeled the milk bins in her librarian handwriting again. He spends Theo's 12:30 nap thinking about how to fix it.
entries.outcome: Asks the assistant how to relabel the bins so they look like Judith's system 'but aren't'; decides to do it quietly after she goes to bed.

entries.what: Tuesday night baby laundry run to the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room.
entries.outcome: Two loads done, onesies folded by 9:30.

entries.what: The 2 a.m. feed, as usual, with Hana taking the 5 a.m.
entries.outcome: Theo goes back down within 20 minutes.

entries.what: Midmorning Elliot works through a section of the online reassessment-software training while Judith watches Theo.
entries.outcome: Finishes one module before the 12:30 nap.

entries.what: Takes the afternoon walk and grabs Phở Bến Thành rare beef pho takeout for dinner because nothing was planned.
entries.outcome: Dinner eaten at the card table next to the half-done lighthouse puzzle.

entries.what: Logs a rough evening of crying in the tracker app and updates the weekly summary tab.
entries.outcome: Notes the crying peaked around 6:15.

entries.what: Another handwritten note from Walter in 211 is taped to the door after a crying stretch in the night. Elliot stews over it, then asks the assistant how to word a reply that says babies cry and he's doing his best, without groveling.
entries.outcome: Drafts a polite, firm reply with no apology and plans to slip it under 211's door.

entries.what: Thursday baby story time at the library at 10:30 with Theo.
entries.outcome: Theo grins at the egret puppet; Elliot chats with other parents.

entries.what: Afternoon nap schedule holds: crib naps at 12:30 and 4, Judith leaves a labeled snack in the fridge.
entries.outcome: A smooth day by baseball standards, 1-0 dad.

entries.what: Halloween: Elliot dresses Theo in a tiny pumpkin onesie and walks him around Marisol Gardens while kids trick-or-treat. Neighbors coo at the baby.
entries.outcome: Hands out a bowl of candy at 209 until it runs out.

entries.what: Judith packs up for her Friday 5 p.m. drive home to Tamsen city and says goodbye to Theo.
entries.outcome: The apartment feels quiet again.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry in the card-only laundry room after the witching hour.
entries.outcome: One load washed and dried before bed.

entries.what: Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier, buying diapers by delivery only and groceries in person.
entries.outcome: Gets eggs, rice, oat milk and chili ingredients.

entries.what: Elliot and Hana go through the week's tracker app log together and talk about Hana's return to work on Monday.
entries.outcome: They agree on a packing routine for her first week back.

entries.what: Evening: chili from the one recipe he knows, with Theo napping in the crib.
entries.outcome: The chili is fine and they eat at the table.

entries.what: Sunday morning slow start; stroller walk on the marsh boardwalk while Hana sleeps in.
entries.outcome: Theo naps through the whole loop.

entries.what: Elliot slides a note under Walter's door and updates his budget spreadsheet, aiming to stay under $5,200 for the month.
entries.outcome: Budget lands just under target.

entries.what: Takes the 2 a.m. feed and logs it in the app before a short night.
entries.outcome: Theo sleeps until 5.
